result.reason: The clause includes the preferred six-month transition assistance at then-current rates and deletion certification, but it does not require data return within 30 days of expiry or termination; the 30-day period begins only upon a Customer request, which could occur much later. It also applies upon termination of any individual Service Option Attachment while requiring return and deletion of all Customer data, potentially disrupting continuing attachments and altering unrelated commercial intent. The provision should tie export to the effective termination date and limit attachment-level obligations to data associated with the terminated attachment.
